blocks.prompt: 5 (i) Find the term involving: \(x^4\) in the expansion of \((3 - 2x)^7\).
blocks.explanation:
Bachon, yahan poori expansion nahi chahiye, sirf woh ek term jis mein \(x^4\) ho.
Is liye general term \(T_{r+1}\) ka use karenge: us mein \(x\) ki power dekh kar \(r\) nikalenge.
Plan: general term likho, \(x\) ki power ko 4 ke barabar rakho, \(r\) nikalo, phir \(r\) wapas daalo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((3 - 2x)^7\).
Humein find karna hai: woh term jis mein \(x^4\) hai.
Tareeqa: General term \(T_{r+1} = \binom{n}{r}a^{n-r}b^r\), jahan \(n = 7\), \(a = 3\), \(b = -2x\). Aath terms likhne ke bajaye seedha sahi term tak pohanchna is ka faida hai.

General term
\[T_{r+1} = \binom{7}{r}3^{7-r}(-2x)^r\]
\[= (-1)^r\binom{7}{r}3^{7-r}2^rx^r\]
Kyun: Power \(r\) bracket ke har factor ko lagti hai: \((-2x)^r = (-1)^r \cdot 2^r \cdot x^r\).
Dhyan dein: \((-2x)^r\) ko \(-2x^r\) likhna ghalat hai; 2 aur minus sign dono ki bhi power lagti hai.

\(r\) chunein
\[x^r = x^4 \Rightarrow r = 4\]
Kyun: General term mein \(x\) ki power \(r\) hai, aur humein power 4 chahiye. Yaad rahe \(r = 4\) ka matlab 5th term \(T_5\) hai, kyunke term number \(r + 1\) hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[35 \times 432 = 15120 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosri tarteeb se multiply kiya (\(27 \times 16 = 432\) pehle), wahi number aaya.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) Find the term involving: \(x^{-2}\) in the expansion of \(\left(x - \frac{2}{x^2}\right)^{13}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(x\) dono terms mein hai: pehle mein upar, doosre mein neeche. Is liye general term mein pehle \(x\) ki saari powers ko ek power bana lenge.
Plan: general term, \(x\) ki ek power, use \(-2\) ke barabar rakho, \(r\) nikalo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(x - \frac{2}{x^2}\right)^{13}\).
Humein find karna hai: woh term jis mein \(x^{-2}\) hai.
Tareeqa: \(T_{r+1}\) jahan \(n = 13\), \(a = x\), \(b = -\frac{2}{x^2}\).

General term aur \(x\) ki power
\[T_{r+1} = \binom{13}{r}x^{13-r}\left(-\dfrac{2}{x^2}\right)^r\]
\[= (-1)^r\binom{13}{r}2^r\dfrac{x^{13-r}}{x^{2r}}\]
\[= (-1)^r\binom{13}{r}2^rx^{13-3r}\]
Kyun: \((x^2)^r = x^{2r}\), power of a power mein indices multiply. Phir divide karne par indices minus: \(13 - r - 2r = 13 - 3r\). Ab poore term mein \(x\) ki sirf ek power hai, jise hum control kar sakte hain.

\(r\) chunein
\[13 - 3r = -2\]
\[-3r = -15 \Rightarrow r = 5\]
Kyun: Power \(-2\) chahiye. \(r = 5\) ek whole number hai aur 0 se 13 ke darmiyan hai, is liye aisa term maujood hai: \(T_6\). Agar \(r\) fraction aata to matlab hota ke aisa koi term hai hi nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[13 - 3(5) = -2 \;\checkmark\]
\[1287 \times 32 = 41184 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Power bhi sahi aur number bhi.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iii) Find the term involving: \(a^4\) in the expansion of \(\left(\frac{2}{x} - a\right)^9\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan humein \(a^4\) wala term chahiye, aur \(a\) sirf doosre term mein hai.
Dhyan rahe: \(a\) is sawal ka apna letter hai, is liye hum formula mein pehle term ko "\(a\)" nahi kahenge, warna confusion hogi.
Plan: general term mein \(a\) ki power \(r\) hai, to \(r = 4\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(\frac{2}{x} - a\right)^9\).
Humein find karna hai: woh term jis mein \(a^4\) hai.
Tareeqa: \(n = 9\), pehla term \(\frac{2}{x}\), doosra term \(-a\).

General term
\[T_{r+1} = \binom{9}{r}\left(\dfrac{2}{x}\right)^{9-r}(-a)^r\]
\[= (-1)^r\binom{9}{r}\dfrac{2^{9-r}}{x^{9-r}}a^r\]
Kyun: Fraction ki power upar neeche dono ko: \(\left(\frac{2}{x}\right)^{9-r} = \frac{2^{9-r}}{x^{9-r}}\). Aur \((-a)^r = (-1)^ra^r\).

\(r\) chunein
\[a^r = a^4 \Rightarrow r = 4\]
Kyun: \(a\) ki power \(r\) hai. To term \(T_5\) hai.

\(r = 4\) rakhein
\[T_5 = (+1)\binom{9}{4}\dfrac{2^5}{x^5}a^4\]
\[= 126 \times \dfrac{32}{x^5}a^4\]
\[= \dfrac{4032a^4}{x^5}\]
Kyun: \(\binom{9}{4} = \frac{9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = \frac{3024}{24} = 126\). \(2^{9-4} = 2^5 = 32\) aur \(x\) ki power bhi 5 (neeche). \(126 \times 32 = 4032\).
Dhyan dein: \(x^5\) denominator mein hai; ise \(x^5\) upar likhna ghalat hoga.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{powers: } (9 - 4) + 4 = 9 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har term mein dono hisson ki powers ka jama \(n = 9\) hota hai: \(\frac{2}{x}\) ki power 5 aur \(a\) ki 4.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iv) Find the term involving: \(y^3\) in the expansion of \((x - \sqrt{y})^{11}\).
blocks.explanation:
Doosre term mein square root hai. Root ko power ki shakal mein likh lein: \(\sqrt{y} = y^{1/2}\); powers ke saath kaam aasaan hota hai.
Plan: general term mein \(y\) ki power \(\frac{r}{2}\) aayegi; use 3 ke barabar rakh kar \(r\) nikaalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((x - \sqrt{y})^{11}\).
Humein find karna hai: woh term jis mein \(y^3\) hai.
Tareeqa: \(n = 11\), \(a = x\), \(b = -\sqrt{y} = -y^{1/2}\).

General term
\[T_{r+1} = \binom{11}{r}x^{11-r}(-\sqrt{y})^r\]
\[= (-1)^r\binom{11}{r}x^{11-r}y^{r/2}\]
Kyun: \((y^{1/2})^r = y^{r/2}\), power of a power mein indices multiply hote hain.

\(r\) chunein
\[\dfrac{r}{2} = 3 \Rightarrow r = 6\]
Kyun: \(y\) ki power 3 chahiye. \(r = 6\) ka matlab 7th term \(T_7\).
Dhyan dein: \(r = 3\) le lena aam ghalti hai; \(r = 3\) par to \(y^{3/2}\) aata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[(\sqrt{y})^6 = y^3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{y}\) ke chhe factors \(y^3\) dete hain, aur 6 even hai is liye sign plus. Sab theek hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(462x^5y\) print karti hai; \(y\) ki power ghayab hai. Sahi term \(462x^5y^3\) hai, kyunke sawal \(y^3\) wala term poochhta hai aur \((\sqrt{y})^6 = y^3\).
